query:
INSERT INTO node_registry (node_id, name, api_endpoint, public_key, last_seen)
        VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, NOW())
        ON CONFLICT (node_id) DO UPDATE SET
            name = EXCLUDED.name,
            api_endpoint = EXCLUDED.api_endpoint,
            public_key = EXCLUDED.public_key,
            last_seen = NOW()
